items.en: «Штучний інтелект не врятував»: біля Запоріжжя збили два російські «Альбатроси-М5» (ArmyInform: ''Artificial intelligence did not save them': two Russian Albatros-M5 drones shot down near Zaporizhzhia')
items.nl: Twee Russische Albatros-M5-verkenningsdrones met neuraal netwerk neergehaald bij Zaporizja
items.sEn: Drone pilots of the 23rd Public Order Protection Brigade "Khortytsia" of Ukraine's National Guard intercepted two Russian Albatros-M5 reconnaissance UAVs that were flying towards the city of Zaporizhzhia, ArmyInform reports, citing a combat video released by the brigade.
